svg.title: Late chunking helps some SciFact queries and hurts others
svg.desc: Sorted query-level SciFact nDCG at 10 differences for late minus naive chunking: 49 queries improved, 229 tied, and 22 worsened. The mean difference is +0.0196, with a paired query-bootstrap interval from +0.0033 to +0.0358. Points above zero favor late chunking; points below zero favor naive chunking.
svg.text: Late chunking helps some SciFact queries and hurts others
Each marker is one test query, sorted by late-minus-naive nDCG@10.
Queries sorted from most negative to most positive difference
